Description: Loads are restrained to industry guidance, checked before departure and after partial unloading.

Title: Vehicles immobilised
Description: Vehicles are braked, switched off and chocked or locked out during loading and maintenance.

Title: Licence checks
Description: Driving licences are checked on recruitment and at least yearly.

Title: Vehicles serviced and checked
Description: Vehicles are serviced to schedule, with walk-round checks before journeys.

Title: Journey planning
Description: Journeys are planned with breaks every two hours and overnight stays where needed.

Title: No handheld phones
Description: Handheld phones are not used while driving; calls wait until parked safely.

Title: Fatigue managed
Description: Working hours and shift patterns limit fatigue, and staff must not drive when tired.

Title: Breakdown cover and procedure
Description: Vehicles have breakdown cover and drivers know what to do if they break down.

Title: Lone working procedure
Description: A lone working procedure sets out what lone workers may and may not do.

Title: Check-in system
Description: Lone workers check in at agreed times, with an escalation plan if they do not.

Title: Lone worker device or app
Description: Lone workers carry a charged phone or lone worker device with an alert function.

Title: High-risk tasks not done alone
Description: High-risk tasks are not carried out by someone working alone.

Title: Conflict resolution training
Description: Staff are trained to recognise and defuse conflict and to leave if threatened.

Title: Incidents recorded and reviewed
Description: Abuse and violent incidents are recorded, reviewed and supported.

Title: Secure layout and alarms
Description: Counters, screens, CCTV and panic alarms protect staff where needed.

Title: Cash kept to a minimum
Description: Cash in tills is kept low and banked at varied times, never alone.

Title: Stress risk assessment
Description: Stress risks are assessed against the HSE Management Standards.

Title: Regular one-to-ones
Description: Managers hold regular one-to-ones and monitor workload and hours.

Title: Employee assistance
Description: Staff can use an employee assistance programme or mental health first aiders.

Title: Workstation assessments
Description: Display screen users complete workstation assessments and adjustments are made.

Title: Adjustable chairs and screens
Description: Adjustable chairs, screen risers and other equipment are provided as needed.
Linked to: Repetitive movements and posture; Display screen equipment

Title: Eye tests
Description: Display screen users are offered eye tests and glasses for screen use when needed.

Title: Home working assessment
Description: Home workers complete a home workstation and environment check.

Title: Hand hygiene
Description: Hands are washed or sanitised before and after care, food handling and glove use.
Linked to: Infection; Biological agents and body fluids; Food poisoning; Leptospirosis (Weil's disease)

Title: Gloves and aprons
Description: Disposable gloves and aprons are worn for contact with body fluids and changed between tasks.
Linked to: Infection; Biological agents and body fluids

Title: Clinical waste segregated
Description: Clinical and offensive waste is segregated, stored securely and collected by a licensed carrier.
Linked to: Infection; Biological agents and body fluids

Title: Sharps bins at point of use
Description: Sharps go straight into a sharps bin at the point of use, which is closed when three-quarters full.

Title: Safer sharps
Description: Safety-engineered needles and devices are used where practicable; needles are never re-sheathed.

Title: Needlestick procedure
Description: A needlestick and splash procedure is displayed and staff know to seek urgent advice.

Title: Hepatitis B vaccination
Description: Staff at risk are offered hepatitis B vaccination.
Linked to: Sharps and needlestick injuries; Biological agents and body fluids

Title: Cleaning schedule
Description: A cleaning schedule covers all areas and is signed off when complete.

Title: Outbreak management
Description: Infection outbreaks are managed with isolation, enhanced cleaning and public health advice.

Title: Seasonal vaccination encouraged
Description: Staff are encouraged to have flu and other seasonal vaccinations.

Title: Food safety management system
Description: A food safety management system based on HACCP is followed and records kept.

Title: Food hygiene training
Description: Food handlers hold food hygiene training suited to their role.

Title: Allergen information
Description: Allergens are recorded for every dish, and staff check with the kitchen before answering customers.

Title: Allergen controls in preparation
Description: Separate equipment, areas or cleaning stops cross-contamination for allergen-free orders.

Title: Temperatures monitored
Description: Fridge, freezer, cooking and hot-holding temperatures are checked and recorded.

Title: Safe knife use
Description: Knives are sharp, the right size for the task, carried point down and stored in racks.

Title: Cut-resistant gloves
Description: Cut-resistant gloves are worn for boning, slicing or cleaning blades.
Linked to: Cutting machinery and blades; Knives and sharp utensils

Title: Thermostatically controlled fryers
Description: Fryers have thermostats and cut-outs; oil is changed cold or with a filter system.

Title: Hot surfaces and liquids
Description: Oven gloves are used, pan handles turned in, and hot liquids carried with care.

Title: Gas Safe servicing
Description: Gas appliances are installed and serviced by a Gas Safe registered engineer.

Title: Gas interlock and ventilation
Description: Commercial kitchen gas supplies are interlocked with the extraction system.

Title: Extraction cleaned
Description: Canopies, filters and ductwork are cleaned regularly to prevent fat build-up.

Title: Pool safety operating procedure
Description: A pool safety operating procedure covers normal operation and emergencies.

Title: Qualified lifeguards
Description: Qualified lifeguards supervise the pool in line with the assessed numbers.

Title: Pool chemicals managed
Description: Pool chemicals are handled by trained staff, stored apart and dosed automatically.

Title: Water quality tested
Description: Pool and spa water is tested several times a day and records kept.

Title: Depth markings and signs
Description: Water depths and pool rules are clearly displayed.

Title: Rescue equipment
Description: Throw lines, poles or buoyancy aids are available near water.

Title: Animal handling procedure
Description: Animals are handled by experienced staff using suitable restraint and handling facilities.

Title: Zoonoses precautions
Description: Staff wash hands, cover cuts and wear protective clothing to prevent infections from animals.
Linked to: Biological agents and body fluids; Animal handling

Title: Protective clothing for animals
Description: Gauntlets, overalls and boots are worn where there is a risk of bites, kicks or scratches.

Title: Pens and races in good repair
Description: Pens, gates, races and crushes are kept in good repair and used for handling.

Title: Sun and weather protection
Description: Staff working outside have sun protection, water and suitable clothing for the weather.

Title: Leptospirosis precautions
Description: Staff cover cuts, wear gloves near water and rats, and carry a warning card.

Title: Certified pesticide users
Description: Pesticides are applied only by certified users following the label and a spray record.

Title: Chainsaw certification
Description: Chainsaws are used only by certificated operators wearing full chainsaw protection.

Title: Chainsaw protective clothing
Description: Chainsaw boots, trousers, gloves, helmet, visor and ear defenders are worn.

Title: Debris guards and exclusion zones
Description: Mowers and strimmers have guards fitted, and others are kept a safe distance away.

Title: Avoid entry
Description: Confined spaces are not entered unless the work cannot be done from outside.

Title: Atmosphere monitoring
Description: The atmosphere is tested before and during entry with a calibrated gas detector.

Title: Cylinders stored safely
Description: Gas cylinders are stored upright, chained, outdoors or in a ventilated store, with valves protected.
Linked to: Gas cylinders; Oxygen and medical gases

Title: Cylinder trolleys
Description: Cylinders are moved on purpose-made trolleys, never rolled or dropped.

Title: Flashback arrestors
Description: Oxy-fuel sets have flashback arrestors and hoses in good condition.

Title: Written scheme of examination
Description: Pressure systems have a written scheme of examination and are examined by a competent person.

Title: Gas detection
Description: Gas detectors with alarms monitor areas where gases could build up.
Linked to: Flammable liquids and gases; Gas appliances and carbon monoxide

Title: Construction phase plan
Description: A construction phase plan is in place and site rules are explained at induction.

Title: Site secured
Description: The site is fenced and secured to keep out the public, especially children.
Linked to: Members of the public and visitors

Title: Excavations supported
Description: Excavations are battered back or supported, inspected daily and protected with barriers.

Title: Competent plant operators
Description: Plant is operated only by trained, certificated operators.

Title: Scaffold inspections
Description: Scaffolds are erected by competent scaffolders and inspected every seven days and after bad weather.

Title: Site PPE
Description: Hard hats, safety boots, hi-vis and gloves are worn on site.

Title: Traffic management plan
Description: A traffic management plan controls deliveries, plant and pedestrians on site.

Title: Silica dust controlled
Description: Cutting stone, brick and concrete uses water suppression or extraction plus RPE.

Title: Public areas checked
Description: Customer areas are checked through the day for hazards and cleaned as needed.
Linked to: Members of the public and visitors

Title: Safety glass and manifestation
Description: Glazing at low level is safety glass and large glass panels have visible markings.

Title: Window restrictors
Description: Windows that vulnerable people can reach are fitted with tamper-proof restrictors.

Title: Lifts maintained and examined
Description: Passenger and goods lifts are maintained and thoroughly examined every six months.

Title: Racking inspected
Description: Racking is installed to load limits, signed with capacities and inspected by a competent person.

Title: Delivery procedure
Description: Deliveries follow an agreed procedure, with drivers directed to a safe area.

Title: Care plans
Description: Care plans record each person's needs and risks and are reviewed regularly.
Linked to: Safeguarding vulnerable people; Falls by residents or service users

Title: Medicines policy
Description: Medicines are handled under a written policy by trained, competent staff.

Title: Medication records
Description: Medication given is recorded at the time on a MAR chart; errors are reported.

Title: Medicines stored securely
Description: Medicines are stored securely at the right temperature, with controlled drugs double-locked.

Title: Safeguarding procedures
Description: Staff are trained in safeguarding and know how to raise concerns.

Title: Recruitment checks
Description: Staff working with vulnerable people or children have appropriate DBS and reference checks.

Title: Bed rails assessed
Description: Bed rails are used only after an individual assessment and checked for gaps and fit.
Linked to: Falls by residents or service users

Title: Oxygen safety
Description: Oxygen is stored and used away from heat, flames and oils, with no-smoking signs.

Title: Falls risk assessment
Description: Each person's falls risk is assessed and aids, alarms and checks are provided.
Linked to: Falls by residents or service users

Title: Behaviour support plans
Description: Behaviour support plans describe triggers and calming approaches for each person.

Title: Radiation protection adviser
Description: An RPA is appointed, local rules are written and controlled areas are defined.

Title: X-ray equipment tested
Description: X-ray equipment is critically examined and quality-assured at set intervals.

Title: Laser local rules
Description: Lasers and IPL are used under local rules by trained operators, with the controlled area signed.

Title: Laser eyewear
Description: Laser-specific eyewear is worn by operators and clients.

Title: Crowd management plan
Description: Capacity, stewarding, routes and communication are planned for the event.

Title: Liaison with authorities
Description: Licensing, emergency services and the venue are consulted before the event.

Title: Temporary structures checked
Description: Stages, marquees and inflatables are erected to the supplier's instructions and checked before use.

Title: Inflatables tested and supervised
Description: Inflatables have a current PIPA or ADIPS tag, are anchored, and are supervised at all times.

Title: Wind speed limits
Description: Wind speeds are monitored and use stops above the manufacturer's limit.

Title: Gym inductions
Description: Members complete an induction and health questionnaire before using the gym.

Title: Fitness equipment serviced
Description: Gym equipment is checked daily and serviced to the manufacturer's schedule.

Title: Qualified instructors
Description: Classes and coaching are led by qualified instructors with first aid cover.

Title: Sauna and steam room controls
Description: Saunas and steam rooms have timers, guarded heaters, alarms and regular checks.

Title: Golfer warnings
Description: Staff working on the course watch play, wait for golfers and wear hi-vis.

Title: Tack checked
Description: Riding equipment is checked before every ride and riders wear approved hats.

Title: Helmets
Description: Approved helmets are worn for riding, cycling, quad bikes and similar activities.

Title: Baler interlocks
Description: Balers and compactors have interlocked gates and are never entered while energised.

Title: Conveyor guarding and stop wires
Description: Conveyors have guards at nip points and pull-wire stops along picking lines.

Title: Waste segregated
Description: Waste is segregated and hazardous items removed before processing.

Title: Dust suppression
Description: Water sprays or misting systems suppress dust in yards and processing areas.

Title: Safe battery charging
Description: Batteries are charged in a ventilated, fire-resistant area with approved chargers and not left charging overnight.

Title: High-voltage vehicle training
Description: Only trained technicians work on electric and hybrid vehicles, using insulated tools and isolation procedures.

Title: Vehicle lifts examined
Description: Vehicle lifts are thoroughly examined every six months and vehicles supported on axle stands.

Title: Pit covers and barriers
Description: Inspection pits are covered or barriered when not in use.

Title: Tyre inflation cage
Description: Split-rim and commercial tyres are inflated in a restraining cage with a remote gauge.

Title: Roadside working
Description: Roadside work uses warning lights, cones, hi-vis and a safe position away from traffic.

Title: Travel risk assessment
Description: Overseas travel is assessed for security, health and insurance, with an itinerary shared.

Title: Health conditions supported
Description: Staff with health conditions are supported with individual plans and reasonable adjustments.

Title: Maintenance scope defined
Description: A written brief sets out which simple tasks staff may do and which must go to a contractor.

Title: No gas, electrical or plumbing work
Description: In-house staff never work on gas, electrical or water systems; faults are reported to the helpdesk.

Title: No drilling into walls
Description: Staff do not drill into walls, floors or ceilings; existing fixings are used.

Title: Kitchen layout and ventilation
Description: The kitchen has enough space, non-slip flooring and canopy extraction over cooking equipment.

Title: Cellar access safe
Description: Cellar hatches have guard rails when open and stairs have handrails and good lighting.

Title: CO2 monitoring in cellars
Description: Cellars with gas cylinders have CO2 and oxygen depletion alarms.

Title: Beer line cleaning procedure
Description: Line cleaner is used to the supplier's method, with lines flushed and taps labelled during cleaning.

Title: Glasswasher use
Description: Glasswashers are allowed to cool before unloading, and chemicals are fed by automatic dosing.

Title: Cleaning chemicals controlled
Description: Cleaning chemicals are diluted correctly, never mixed, and used with gloves and eye protection.

Title: Housekeeping trolleys
Description: Housekeeping trolleys are used and kept under weight limits; linen bags are not overfilled.

Title: Bed making technique
Description: Beds are made using good posture, working around the bed instead of overreaching.

Title: Laundry handled safely
Description: Soiled linen is bagged at source, washed at disinfection temperatures and kept apart from clean linen.

Title: Spa pool operation
Description: Spa pools are disinfected, filtered and tested to HSE guidance, with bathing load and session times limited.

Title: Bath water temperature checked
Description: Bath and shower water is checked with a thermometer before the person gets in (no hotter than 44°C).

Title: Dementia-friendly environment
Description: Signage, lighting, colour contrast and secure garden access help people with dementia move safely.

Title: Seizure management plans
Description: People with epilepsy have a seizure management plan and staff are trained in emergency medication.

Title: Changing units with steps
Description: Changing units have steps so children can climb up, avoiding lifting from the floor.

Title: Staffing ratios
Description: Staff-to-child or staff-to-client ratios meet the required levels at all times.

Title: Play equipment inspected
Description: Play equipment and surfaces are checked daily and inspected annually by a competent inspector.

Title: Off-site visit plan
Description: Trips are planned and approved, with consent, ratios, first aid and emergency contacts in place.

Title: Science practicals controlled
Description: Practicals follow CLEAPSS guidance, are prepared by technicians and supervised by teachers.

Title: Kiln controls
Description: Kilns have interlocks or are in a locked area, with ventilation and warning signs while firing.

Title: Workshop rules for pupils
Description: Pupils use machines only after instruction, under supervision, with guards and eye protection.

Title: Amalgam and mercury controlled
Description: Encapsulated amalgam is used, separators fitted, and spill kits available.

Title: Instrument decontamination
Description: Instruments are decontaminated and sterilised following national guidance, with autoclave records.

Title: Cytotoxic drugs handled safely
Description: Cytotoxic drugs are prepared and disposed of using closed systems and specific PPE.

Title: Anaesthetic gas scavenging
Description: Anaesthetic gases are scavenged and equipment leak-checked.

Title: Skin sensitivity tests
Description: Patch or skin sensitivity tests are done 48 hours before colour and certain treatments.

Title: Client consultation
Description: A consultation and medical history check is completed before each treatment.

Title: Qualified practitioners
Description: Treatments are carried out only by suitably qualified and insured practitioners, with a prescriber where required.

Title: Solvent controls
Description: Dry cleaning machines are closed-loop, maintained, and solvent stored and disposed of safely.

Title: Safe roof access
Description: Access to roofs is by a secured ladder or tower, with edge protection at the access point.

Title: Scaffold tagged
Description: Scaffolds carry a tag showing the latest inspection and are not altered by anyone except scaffolders.

Title: Disc cutters controlled
Description: Disc cutters are used by trained operators with the correct blade, guard and water suppression.

Title: Low-level platforms for decorating
Description: Hop-ups and podiums are used instead of chairs or trestles.

Title: Water and heating isolated
Description: Systems are isolated, drained and cooled before work, and soldering uses a heat mat.

Title: Glass lifting equipment
Description: Glass is moved with suction lifters and A-frames, and cut-resistant gloves and sleeves are worn.

Title: Wood dust extraction
Description: Woodworking machines are connected to extraction that is examined every 14 months.

Title: Braked machines
Description: Woodworking machines with run-down times over 10 seconds are fitted with brakes.

Title: Welding screens and fume extraction
Description: Welding bays have screens and on-torch or local fume extraction.

Title: Welding PPE
Description: Welding helmets with the right filter, leather gloves and flame-resistant clothing are worn.

Title: Metalworking fluids managed
Description: Fluid concentration and bacteria are checked weekly, and machines have splash guards and mist extraction.

Title: Shot blasting PPE
Description: Blasters wear air-fed helmets and protective suits, and cabinets are kept sealed.

Title: Mixer bowl guards
Description: Mixers have interlocked bowl guards; bowls are never reached into while moving.

Title: Flour dust controlled
Description: Flour is added slowly, mixers start at low speed and dust is cleaned by vacuum, not brushing.

Title: Tail lifts used safely
Description: Tail lifts are thoroughly examined every six months; loads are secured and operators stand clear of edges.

Title: Coupling procedure
Description: Drivers follow a coupling procedure including tug test and parking brake checks.

Title: Cab access steps
Description: Drivers use steps and handholds facing the vehicle; no jumping from cabs or trailers.

Title: Roll-over protection
Description: Tractors have roll-over protection and seat belts are worn; quad bikes have helmets and training.

Title: PTO guards
Description: PTO shafts are fully guarded and machinery is switched off before clearing blockages.

Title: Safe stop
Description: Before leaving a vehicle or clearing machinery: handbrake on, controls neutral, engine off, key out.

Title: No entry into grain bins
Description: Grain bins are not entered while emptying; entry needs a permit, harness and standby person.

Title: Shed ventilation
Description: Poultry sheds are ventilated and ammonia levels checked before work.

Title: Tree climbing teams
Description: Tree climbing needs a minimum of two trained people with an aerial rescue plan.

Title: Chipper safety
Description: Chippers are fed from the side, with feed controls tested and nobody reaching into the chute.

Title: Golf buggy rules
Description: Buggies are driven only on approved paths by authorised drivers, with passenger limits.

Title: Quad and Segway training
Description: Riders receive training and a safety briefing and stay within marked routes.

Title: Stable and yard layout
Description: Stables have wide doors, secure fittings and non-slip yards.

Title: Accessible routes
Description: Routes, ramps and facilities are accessible to people with disabilities.

Title: Cashing-up procedure
Description: Cash is counted out of public view, in a secure room, with two people where possible.

Title: Mezzanine edge protection
Description: Mezzanine floors have guard rails, signed load limits and gated loading points.

Title: Hot drinks equipment
Description: Coffee machines are maintained, steam wands purged away from the body and descaled to schedule.

Title: Mechanical sheeting
Description: Skips and RoRo containers are sheeted with mechanical systems or from a sheeting gantry.

Title: Shear controls and guarding
Description: Shears have guards, two-hand or remote controls and are fed with handling equipment.

Title: Hazardous waste procedure
Description: Hazardous items found in waste are isolated, labelled and stored for specialist disposal.

Title: Pre-travel briefing
Description: Travellers are briefed on local risks, vaccinations and emergency contacts before departure.

Title: Event planning and alcohol
Description: Social events are planned with safe transport home, sensible alcohol provision and a responsible host.

Title: Safety signs at water
Description: No-diving and depth signs, and life-saving equipment, are provided at the water's edge.

Title: Powered gate safety devices
Description: Powered gates have safety edges, photocells and force limits, tested at each service.

Title: Crane and lifting gear examined
Description: Overhead cranes and lifting accessories are thoroughly examined and operators trained.

Title: Mechanical post drivers
Description: Post drivers and augers are used with guards and hearing protection instead of manual rammers where possible.

Title: Cleaning machines used safely
Description: Cleaning machines are checked, cables managed, and wet areas signed until dry.

Title: Fogging procedure
Description: Rooms are cleared and sealed, smoke detectors isolated, and re-entry delayed until the product has settled.

Title: Exhibition build plan
Description: Stand building follows the organiser's rules, with materials fire-rated and work at height planned.

Title: Car park duties
Description: Car park staff wear hi-vis, stand in safe positions and use agreed hand signals.

Title: Agency and host liaison
Description: The host provides a site induction and the agency confirms the worker is trained for the role.

Title: Home workers kept in contact
Description: Home workers have regular contact with their manager and a way to report problems.
